items.title: How much does the gap before an ask change how help reads?
items.description: Engineer B compressed a year of relationship-building into 1 month right before an ask, and it read as transactional. Engineer A spread the same kind of help across roughly 12 months with no ask attached, and got unprompted support. Drag the slider to see how the gap between help given and an ask made shifts perceived genuineness, holding the help itself constant. This is a teaching model aligned with L2's rough trend, not a measured formula.
